items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1957-03-26
items.q: I don't remember them anymore... I said, no, I don't. He had to explain to me who he was before I could recognize him.

ctx.x: You know, some of those fellas there, as I told you, I don't remember them anymore. Don't you know? By name or even the features, the faces, you know. I don't remember them anymore. As I told you about this man, Lala, of course, he's pretty good in age now. He's great-headed. And he come up to me and he asked me, he said, I know him. I said, no, I don't. He had to explain to me who he was before I could recognize him. I know him.
Well, he had a band across the river with Emmett Hardy. Hardy? You remember Hardy?
